payload.text: **NEVER TRUNCATE THE OUTPUT OF `git remote -v`** (hv, 2026-10-23, verbatim: "NEVER truncate the output of "git remote -v" because doing so cuts off valid remotes"). A `| head`, a `cut -c` or a pager over that listing hides a remote the next cut pushes to (a cut pushes to every remote listed unless `release.remotes` is declared). Read it whole, quote it whole, before any cut and in any report that names remotes.
